<b>Yumamas</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are large gelatinous drifters, long lost to time and living on only in memory.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Floats around idly, shaking and then slamming itself at Hornet in a straight line if she is in its general vicinity. <br>
Deals {{Damage|2}} of contact damage.<br>
Spawns 5 [[Yuma]]s on death.

== Location ==
Yumamas can only be found in [[Crust King Khann]]'s [[Elegy of the Deep|Memory]] of the [[Coral Tower]] during [[Acts|Act 3]].
